description: Патчи к FreeZona World. В версии 1.2.5 добавлена поддержка FreeZona 3.0.78 (1078), обновлены хуки выбора качества и ориентации под изменённую схему обфускации R8, оптимизировано отключение телеметрии и аналитики.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Disables internal event tracking, ClickHouse telemetry, crash reporting, and AppMetrica SDK to enhance privacy and battery life.

patches.name: Force landscape player
patches.description: Switches to landscape orientation when movie or series playback starts.

patches.name: Install as a separate app
patches.description: Installs the patched app beside the original one under its own package name and app name, so the original keeps updating on its own.

options.description: Package name of the separate install. Must be unique among the installed copies.
Name to tell the separate install apart from the original one.
ARGB color of the 'Z' launcher icon mark, e.g. #FFA855F7. Leave empty to keep the original blue color.
ARGB color of the launcher icon background, e.g. #FF2B1E3F. Leave empty to keep the original dark background.

patches.name: Preferred quality priority
patches.description: Plays at the quality from "Preferred quality" instead of the last quality chosen by hand, and waits for preferred quality sources before falling back.

options.description: Time to wait for slow 1080p stream providers (torrents/mirrors) before falling back to lower quality. If 1080p is found earlier, playback starts immediately. Allowed range: 1 to 30 seconds.

patches.name: Video buffer
patches.description: Increases ExoPlayer video buffer duration to eliminate stutter and rebuffering on slow connections.

options.description: Maximum duration of video ahead to buffer (default 20 min, original was 6 min).
Minimum duration of video to buffer before playback considers itself adequately buffered (default 10 min, original was 5 min).
Duration of media to buffer before initial playback starts (default 3 s, original was 2.5 s).
Duration of media to buffer before playback resumes after rebuffering (default 5 s, original was 5 s).

release_notes:
## 🇬🇧 English

### What's new
- Support for FreeZona World `3.0.78` (versionCode 1078)
- Adapted patch anchors to R8 obfuscator changes (repositioned class and method mappings)

### Fixes
- Fixed Preferred quality priority hooks for FreeZona 3.0.78 (added `Ly1c$a;->a` resolution filter, `Lv5e;-><init>` quality constructor, and updated stream evaluation loop string)
- Fixed Force landscape player to handle lambda method references (`Lbrc;->invoke()Ljava/lang/Object;`)
- Fixed Disable analytics hooks to support modified ClickHouse sender signatures and dispatcher class structure

---

## 🇷🇺 Русский

### Что нового
- Добавлена поддержка FreeZona World `3.0.78` (код версии 1078)
- Адаптированы хуки патчей под обновлённую схему обфускации R8

### Исправления
- Исправлен патч «Приоритет качества» (Preferred quality priority) для FreeZona 3.0.78: добавлены хуки парсера разрешения `Ly1c$a;->a`, конструктора `Lv5e;-><init>` и обновлена сигнатурная строка цикла оценки стримов
- Исправлен патч «Автоповорот в ландшафт» (Force landscape player): снято ограничение на возвращаемый тип для поддержки лямбды `Lbrc;->invoke()` в 3.0.78
- Исправлен патч «Отключение аналитики» (Disable analytics): обновлены правила поиска диспетчера аналитики и отправителя ClickHouse с учётом статических методов и изменённого количества аргументов

---

**Full changelog / Полный список изменений:** https://github.com/PerfLite/morphe-patches-zona/compare/v1.2.4...v1.2.5
